newsitem.title: USA: AT&T says Ameritech move premature.
newsitem.headline: AT&T says Ameritech move premature.

text.p: AT&T Corp said on Thursday that Ameritech Corp was premature in its filing to offer long distance service in Michigan because no major competitors are yet in its local calling market in the state.
"It's obvious that real local service competition does not yet exist in Ameritech's Michigan territory," said Ray O'Connell, an AT&T vice president in public relations.
An AT&T spokesman said that of the long list of interconnection agreements Ameritech said it had, only Brooks Fiber Properties Inc had local residential customers -- and only 5,000 of them.
He said AT&T's own deal with Ameritech had yet to be approved by the Michigan Public Service Commission.
"We can't say when we will be able to enter the local market in Michigan," the AT&T spokesman said.
AT&T said the electronic system for switching customers between long distance carriers didn't yet work with Ameritech, and it was impractical to do it manually.
